pool.arabic: بأول إسبوع إلي بلندن صارت عندي صدمة ثقافية.
pool.arabicTashkeel: بأوَّل إسبوع إلي بلَندَن صارَت عِندي صَدمة ثَقافية.
pool.english: In my first week in London I had culture shock.
pool.transliteration: b-awwal isboo3 ili b-landan saarat 3indi sadma thagaafiyya.

pool.english: Respect for elders is very important in Iraq.
In Germany, punctuality is very important.
Their food was strange for me.
It took me months to adapt.
Many Iraqi expatriates live in Sweden.
What's the difference between the two cultures?

pool.arabic: أكو تشابه كبير بين الأكل العراقي والتركي.
pool.arabicTashkeel: أكو تَشابُه كْبير بين الأكِل العِراقي والتُّركي.
pool.english: There's a big similarity between Iraqi and Turkish food.
pool.transliteration: aku tashaabuh chbeer been il-akil il-3iraaqi w-it-turki.

pool.arabic: بالعراق، عيب ترفض الأكل من المضيف.
pool.arabicTashkeel: بالعِراق، عيب تِرفُض الأكِل مِن المِضيف.
pool.english: In Iraq, it's shameful to refuse food from your host.
Culture shock is normal at first.
In Iraq, the greeting includes a kiss on the cheek.
It's strange that shops close early here.
I compared prices in both countries.
What's the difference between Baghdad and Amman?
There are similarities in the language.
The foreigner was surprised by the hospitality.
Iraqi children are polite with guests.
The difference is in the details.
It's shameful to eat with your left hand.
Punctuality is a sign of respect.

sentences.english: My cousin is an expatriate who lives in Germany.

sentences.arabic: بالأول صارت عنده صدمة ثقافية: الناس كانوا صريحين هواية، والمواعيد مضبوطة كلش.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: بالأوَّل صارَت عِندَه صَدمة ثَقافية: النّاس كانوا صَريحين هْوايَة، والمَواعيد مَضبوطة كُلَّش.
sentences.english: At first he had culture shock: people were very direct, and punctuality was very strict.
sentences.transliteration: bil-awwal saarat 3inda sadma thagaafiyya: in-naas chaanaw sareee7een hwaaya, w-il-mawaa3eed madhbooTa kullish.

sentences.arabic: بالعراق، إذا الضيف تأخر، ما يخالف؛ بألمانيا شي غريب.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: بالعِراق، إذا الضَّيف تأخَّر، ما يْخالِف؛ بألمانيا شي غَريب.
sentences.english: In Iraq, if a guest comes late, it's no problem; in Germany it's strange.
sentences.transliteration: bil-3iraaq, itha idh-dheef t2akhkhar, ma ykhaalif; b-almaanya shi ghareeb.

sentences.arabic: بس قارن بين الثقافتين ولقى تشابه: الثنتين يحترمون العائلة والتعليم.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: بَس قارَن بين الثَّقافتين ولِقى تَشابُه: الثِّنتين يِحتِرمون العائلة والتَّعليم.
sentences.english: But he compared the two cultures and found similarities: both respect family and education.
sentences.transliteration: bas gaaran been ith-thagaafteen w-liga tashaabuh: ith-thinteen yi7tirmoon il-3aa2ila w-it-ta3leem.

sentences.arabic: بعد سنتين تأقلم، بس بعده مشتاق للتحية والضيافة العراقية.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: بَعد سَنتين تأقلَم، بَس بَعدَه مِشتاق للتَّحية والضِّيافة العِراقية.
sentences.english: After two years he adapted, but he still misses the Iraqi greeting and hospitality.
sentences.transliteration: ba3d santeen t2aglam, bas ba3ada mishtaag lit-ta7iyya w-idh-dhiyaafa il-3iraaqiyya.

sentences.arabic: إذا تزور العراق، إقبل الشاي والأكل؛ الرفض ينحسب عيب.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: إذا تْزور العِراق، إقبَل الشاي والأكِل؛ الرَّفُض يِنحِسِب عيب.
sentences.english: If you visit Iraq, accept the tea and food; refusing is considered shameful.
sentences.transliteration: itha tzoor il-3iraaq, igbal ich-chaay w-il-akil; ir-rafudh yin7isib 3eeb.

sentences.arabic: خليك مأدب ويا الكبار، وسلم عالكل من تدخل.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: خَلّيك مْأدَّب ويّا الكْبار، وسَلِّم عالكُل مِن تِدخُل.
sentences.english: Be polite with elders, and greet everyone when you enter.
sentences.transliteration: khalleek m2addab wiyya il-chbaar, w-sallim 3al-kull min tidkhul.

sentences.arabic: إحترم العادات، وراح تكون مرحب بيك بكل مكان.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: إحتِرِم العادات، وراح تكون مُرَحَّب بيك بكُل مَكان.
sentences.english: Respect the customs, and you will be welcome everywhere.
sentences.transliteration: i7tirim il-3aadaat, w-raa7 tkoon mura77ab beek b-kull makaan.

scenario.situation: An Iraqi friend who has just moved to Europe calls the student to talk about adapting to the new culture.
scenario.otherRole: An Iraqi expatriate experiencing culture shock.
scenario.goalEnglish: Compare customs between Iraq and another country (greetings, punctuality, directness, hospitality), talk about culture shock and give advice on adapting.
